reachable.2: repository or missing STATUS environment error
reachable.4: digest drift alone, and currently also an extra-column parse collision
reachable.6: missing receipt plus missing concurrence with no digest drift
reachable.7: other multi-class combinations, such as missing+drift or concurrence+drift

exit_reachability.ruling: All documented failure exits are reachable in principle. Exit 7 is not covered by the ten-arm selftest; no arm combines drift with either missing class.

extra_column.observed: ARM 10 turns a ten-column row into digest drift because bash read assigns the trailing field(s) to the final digest variable.
extra_column.why_it_matters: Q19's receipt_type is intended to be column 10. With the current nine-field parser, a valid receipt_digest plus receipt_type will be read as a corrupted digest and every such row will false-RED with exit 4.
extra_column.required_fix: Migrate the parser and status schema to ten columns before adding receipt_type. Validate exact field count; do not treat extra columns as a digest mismatch. Add a ten-column positive arm and a malformed-field-count error arm.

short_row.observed: ARM 9 returns exit 5 because a six-column RULED_OUT row leaves concurrence empty. That is the same observable state as a valid-width row with an empty kill_concurrence field.
short_row.why: The parser never checks column count. ARM 9 passes because the semantic concurrence check fires, not because the row is recognized as malformed. A short CLEARED row could pass and a short RULED_OUT row is not distinguished from missing concurrence.
short_row.required_fix: Validate field count before semantic checks and assign a distinct schema-error code. Keep the concurrence fail-closed arm separately.

commit_claim_audit.claim: every failing class is reported and exit code names which classes fired
commit_claim_audit.bound: The counters report missing, drift, and concurrence separately; exit 7 groups several combinations and is not class-specific. The parser still lacks schema validation, so malformed rows can enter the counters through field collapse.
commit_claim_audit.claim: ten arms pass including three new ones
commit_claim_audit.bound_2: The arms do not prove future column-10 compatibility or reach exit 7.

final: The disaggregation repair fixes the original masking defect, but ARM 10 is a warning, not a safe schema policy. Q19 receipt_type cannot be landed by appending column 10 until parser/schema migration is implemented.
